records.model_relation: the maintained cubical relative homotopy groups, singular relative chain complexes, coherent singleton-pair deformation, and standard simplex-disk-cube homeomorphisms
records.note: All thirty-three listed declarations are sorry-free Lean 4. Audited headline axiom closures contain only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. This proves the normalized representative's Hurewicz image definitionally and makes the deformation identity available for a surjectivity proof. Identifying the explicit source class with the previously oriented cube fundamental class and proving the alternating-face descent relation remain before the classical first-nonvanishing Hurewicz isomorphism, so no exact lattice cell is recolored.
records.result: a singular simplex whose faces lie in a subspace defines an explicit natural relative homology class; coherent simplex deformation acts as the identity on relative homology; the simplex-to-cube homeomorphism supplies an explicit cube-pair source class whose natural Hurewicz evaluator sends every normalized cubical representative exactly to its relative singular-simplex class
